title: (2025 JUL) Cumulative Updates for Business Central
summary: Cumulative updates for Business Central replace previous updates and fix vulnerabilities across multiple versions. The latest update should always be installed. Updates are available for versions 26, 25, and 24, with older versions no longer receiving updates.
key_points: Cumulative updates replace previously released updates and include security vulnerability fixes
Latest update should always be installed to maintain security
Updates include both general hotfixes and localization-specific hotfixes for all countries
Version 26 (2025 Wave 1), version 25 (2024 Wave 2), and version 24 (2024 Wave 1) are actively updated
Versions 23 and earlier are no longer receiving updates

quotes.text: Some updates additionally fix vulnerabilities, so the latest update should always be installed.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the critical importance of keeping systems current for security protection

quotes.text: Updates include hotfixes that apply to all countries and hotfixes that apply to specific local versions.
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that updates address both global and region-specific issues in localized installations
